notes.title: New build with reported bugs fixed
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've been hearing some great feedback for The Perfectionist. I'm glad many of you have enjoyed the gameplay. I've seen some reports on some of the glitches found and I've just added a new build that fixes those glitches. The glitches fixed:
- Fixed the glitch in the toxic lab with the red levers
- I disabled the save feature for the Power Supply Lab, so now the electricity will not go invisible
-I've fixed the glitch that occurs when you lose a hacking minigame and the party's faces and battle sprites disappear
-I've added more autosave locations especially before some of the more difficult challenges. Also, every time you find a Code Page
-Fixed the glitch in the Compressor Room that prevents menu access
Your feedback is very helpful. Thank you all again for your support and reviews.
